controller: Offline experiential controller, concurrent supplied drives, bounded persistent plans, grounded beliefs, and local conversation rules
summaryDefinition: Survival, risk, travel and duration summaries are per-character means. Plan and communication summaries are totals over the selected trials.
sensorArchitecture: Engine reserves and fatigue are quantitative. Both offline decisions and model observations receive categorical bodily signals. Peer observations contain only visible appearance and remembered dialogue. Exact metrics below are developer measurements.
priors: Physiology, action affordances, categorical sensory vocabulary, motivation names, bounded recognition templates, navigation, exploration/preparation strategies, and offline dialogue rules are programmed priors. Beliefs and useful outcomes accumulate from actual observations; this does not train LLM weights.
independentSuccessDefinition: Ordinary collected water/food consumption giving at least 15 useful reserve points; water credited at most once per fill and apple at most once per collected item.
control: Same two bodies, current local observations, qualitative drives, planning, social protocol and resources; learning=false disables retained low-level terrain/resource/action values/temporal learning/procedures. Cognitive and conversation data are still present; this is not a memory-free agent or a full ablation of the v0.5 architecture.

limitations: Two matched seeds per scenario are functional probes, not statistical evidence of general reliability.
Fixed world geometry; character RNG and weather seeds vary.
Near-refuge hot/night fixtures do not establish discovery of a distant cave before distress.
Unanswered-journal fixtures inject initial questions to test nonblocking behavior; other conversation is produced by the offline controller. No human responses are injected.
Food-depleted trials intentionally lack food; eventual harm is expected.
900-second ordinary trials cross one resource renewal; they do not establish indefinite survival or a complete one-hour day.
No live Ollama inference, neural-brain simulation, LLM weight learning, arbitrary skill invention, or civilization emergence is established by these probes.
Conversation in these trials is supplied offline dialogue; configured Ollama can produce language and plans but must be tested separately.
The learning-disabled control retains higher-level cognitive/social machinery, so comparisons cannot attribute differences to every individual new subsystem.
